facts.fact: The Ministry of General Education and Instruction says its Data and Statistics Unit operates the Education Management Information System and ran the 2021 education census, with the second wholly ministry-run exercise through EMIS (the first was 2018), covering more than 90% of schools and publishing national education statistics.

systems.platform: Kobo Humanitarian online server for 2021 census tablet collection
systems.owner: Ministry of General Education and Instruction, Data and Statistics Unit
